# Saarthi

> The trusted pilgrimage guide and digital companion for Tirupati and Tirumala devotees. Saarthi provides verified real-time TTD darshan wait times, free SSD token counter status, 74+ offline precinct maps, ghat road safety guidance, and authentic Sthala Puranas.

Saarthi is designed to remove uncertainty and anxiety for pilgrims visiting the seven sacred hills of Tirumala and surrounding heritage temples in Tirupati.

## Key Sections & Real-Time Intelligence

- [Live TTD Darshan Alerts & Wait Times](https://www.saarthiguide.in/alerts): Up-to-date queue waiting hours, compartment statuses, and free Slotted Sarva Darshan (SSD) token availability across Bhudevi, Srinivasam, and Vishnu Nivasam complexes.
- [Interactive Temple Directory & Precinct Maps](https://www.saarthiguide.in/explore): Curated directory of 74+ temples with offline vector maps, walking routes from entrance to sanctum, footwear stands, laddu counters, and wheelchair access.
- [Pilgrim Darshan Essentials & Logistics](https://www.saarthiguide.in/essentials): Essential checklist including official TTD dress code rules (Dhoti/Kurta for men, Saree/Churidar for women), luggage deposit counters, mobile lockers, and Tirumala Ghat Road 28-minute minimum descent safety rules.
- [2026 Festival Calendar & Crowd Rush Predictor](https://www.saarthiguide.in/festivals): 172+ verified festival dates, Telugu Panchangam tithis, Srivari Salakatla Brahmotsavams schedule, Vaikuntha Ekadasi, Rathasapthami, and crowd rush intelligence.
- [Trip Cost & Schedule Estimator](https://www.saarthiguide.in/trip-estimator): Plan yatra budget, vehicle toll passes, accommodation costs, and timing optimization for elderly family members.
- [Sacred Sthala Puranas & Stories](https://www.saarthiguide.in/learn/stories): Ancient lore of Lord Venkateswara Swamy, Goddess Padmavathi Ammavaru, Swami Pushkarini, and Saint Ramanuja.

## Prominent Temples & Shrines

- [Sri Venkateswara Swamy Temple (Tirumala)](https://www.saarthiguide.in/place/venkateswara): The world's most revered Vaishnavite pilgrimage destination situated atop the Venkatadri hill of the Seshachalam range.
- [Sri Padmavathi Ammavari Temple (Tiruchanur)](https://www.saarthiguide.in/place/padmavathi-temple): Abode of Goddess Lakshmi as Sri Padmavathi Devi, traditionally visited prior to or immediately following Tirumala darshan.
- [Sri Govindaraja Swamy Temple (Tirupati)](https://www.saarthiguide.in/place/govindaraja): 1000-year-old historic shrine consecrated by Saint Ramanujacharya featuring Lord Vishnu in Yoga Nidra posture.
- [Sri Kapileswara Swamy Temple (Kapila Theertham)](https://www.saarthiguide.in/place/kapila-theertham): The holy Shiva kshetram nestled beneath natural waterfalls at the base of the Tirumala hill range.
- [Sri Kalyana Venkateswara Swamy Temple (Srinivasa Mangapuram)](https://www.saarthiguide.in/place/srinivasa-mangapuram): The sanctified spot where Lord Venkateswara and Goddess Padmavathi resided for six months following their divine wedding.
- [Sri Bedi Anjaneya Swamy Temple](https://www.saarthiguide.in/place/bedi-anjaneya): Ancient Hanuman shrine directly facing the Mahadwaram of Srivari Temple in Tirumala.

## Technical Capabilities

- 100% Offline Precinct Vector Maps (SVG-based, zero external tile dependencies, GPS location tracking).
- Multilingual accessibility: Full English and Telugu (తెలుగు) support.
- Zero tracking of personal user credentials; offline-first privacy architecture.
